capabilities: Share selected folders with an Inbox Hero account
Leave out notes that look like they hold passwords, keys, card numbers or seed phrases
Save emails sent from Inbox Hero as notes in the Inbox Hero folder
Upload notes one way without changing them
disambiguation: Not an Obsidian inbox or task-capture tool; it shares selected folders with the Inbox Hero email service.
extras: Sync is one way and notes are never changed; the plugin talks only to the Inbox Hero service to upload shared notes and fetch emails sent to the vault.
problem: Email drafting tools cannot see the notes in a vault, so replies lack the user's own written context.

relations.evidence: Share the folders you choose with your Inbox Hero account

summary: Connector that shares chosen vault folders with an Inbox Hero account so email drafts and answers can use your notes.
